config.exclusion_reason: World-v3 eval behaviours whose witness program or skeleton already appears in a training set: stack_pbe_v4 (either split) or stack_pbe_world_v3 train. Found by world-plus-v4-policy (#134); removed from the corpus with the owner's approval. mbpp-62 and mbpp-924 are verbatim v4 train witnesses and mbpp-458 shares a v4 train skeleton; the other eight recur inside world train because v3 split by behaviour-id hash rather than by skeleton.

generator_description: Behaviours are human-written programming problems with tests (codearc, leetcode, mbpp) restricted to ints and flat int lists; witnesses were authored by Claude and Codex sessions in macro form over experiments/world_behaviours/macros*.txt and expanded to the basis; examples are the upstream tests extended by inputs that keep or deliberately break the properties the given inputs share, run through the reference solution. Split policy: by-behaviour-hash eval_share=0.1.
